tabs.one: Tech markets face a reality check as AI spending concerns weigh on major stocks, even as Black Friday deals and regional hardware rollouts dominate consumer news.
tabs.html:
The big stories

  • AI Market Reality Check: Global tech stocks experienced a massive sell-off, shedding trillions amid growing investor skepticism over whether heavy infrastructure spending will yield sustainable financial returns 6057.
  • Protesters Storm Meta Offices in India: Members of the Indian National Congress youth wing protested and entered Meta’s Delhi offices, demanding the restoration of accounts belonging to party leaders 16.
  • Anthropic's Milestone IPO: Anthropic's stock market debut minted thousands of employee millionaires, with roughly 96% of its workforce holding equity valued above $1 million 55.
  • Regulatory and Trade Pressures: India imposed a steep 162.5% effective tax and duty on bulk Scotch whisky imports, complicating UK trade pact talks 59, while the Maharashtra FDA suspended Amazon and BigBasket dark store licenses in Pune over hygiene violations 56.
  • Signal Enhances Privacy: Facing the "existential threat" of AI surveillance, messaging app Signal began restricting mobile screenshots on both Android and iOS 72.

Launches & products

  • Motorola Edge 70 Neo 5G: Confirmed for an India launch featuring three key upgrades 37.
  • Ulefone Armor 35 Pro: Set to go on sale December 7 for $430, featuring a 1.2 km laser rangefinder and an 11,000 mAh battery 15.
  • Belkin 40W USB-C Charger: Launched in China as a compact, single-port charger designed for iPhones and iPads 13.
  • Google Gemini AI Tasks: Expanded to offer free task automation features for users in India 66.

The market angle

  • Adani Enterprises / Mumbai International Airport Ltd (MIAL): Gulf airlines warned of diplomatic escalation over a proposal to temporarily shift 14 international flights from Mumbai to the upcoming Adani-operated Navi Mumbai International Airport 51.
  • Amazon & BigBasket: Local operations hit as the Maharashtra FDA suspended food licenses for dark stores in Pune due to safety and hygiene violations 56.
